test_dates.py has failing tests. Fix the bug in dates.py and return the whole file as a block starting with '# file: dates.py'.

# file: dates.py
def is_leap(year):
    return year % 4 == 0


def days_in_year(year):
    return 366 if is_leap(year) else 365

# file: test_dates.py
import unittest
from dates import is_leap, days_in_year


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_2024(self):
        self.assertTrue(is_leap(2024))
    def test_2023(self):
        self.assertFalse(is_leap(2023))
    def test_1900(self):
        self.assertFalse(is_leap(1900))
    def test_2000(self):
        self.assertTrue(is_leap(2000))
    def test_2100(self):
        self.assertEqual(days_in_year(2100), 365)
    def test_2400(self):
        self.assertEqual(days_in_year(2400), 366)
    def test_1996(self):
        self.assertTrue(is_leap(1996))
